column1: # OE_STRUCTURE_CLASSES v1.7.0 — the ONE table of the structure classes, read by the structure check, the release check and the publisher (through oe_structure_classes_v1_1_0.py). The classes are those of the decision procedure in OE_STRUCTURE_EXCEPTION_TAXONOMY_v1_0_4.md section 2; first matching question decides: G1 Q1, G2 Q2, T1 Q3, C1 Q4, H1 Q5 and Q7, R1 Q6, U3 Q8, U2 Q9, U1 Q10, X Q11.

# v1.1.0 (2026-10-07): the columns `match`, `structure`, `release` and `publish` are what the tools read (see the header of oe_structure_classes_v1_1_0.py); the earlier `skipped_by_tools_today` column is gone because the tools now take their lists from here. A nested folder with its own VERSION.txt that no `unit=` row names is reported as rule X1. The release check no longer skips by words in names (`negative`, `invalid` and the like); it skips whole folders only. Changing what a tool skips means changing a row here, in a release of this package.

# v1.2.0 (2026-10-07, plan v1.13.0 item 48): the registrations are a unit like any other. The row R1 no longer skips a folder by name: `unit=oe-pack/06-registrant-deposits` is read by all three tools, so the unit's one T-Box, one A-Box and one SHACL file are checked, released and published like every other package's. The copies of other packages (C1) and the test inputs (T1) inside it keep their own rows.

# v1.3.0 (2026-10-07, plan v1.14.0): the retired snapshot moved into the governance archive (its three role files), so its row is gone; the row H1 archive covers it. No tool skipped anything else because of this row.

# v1.4.0 (2026-10-07, plan v1.15.0): the lineage register of the a domain ecosystem overview page is a named unit (row U2). The owner ruled on 2026-10-06 that lineage is independent of the domain ontology and meets the three-file rule on its own; OE accepted the package's nested VERSION.txt as the mark of that unit the same day; only the table row was missing, which is why rule X1 reported it.

# v1.5.0 (2026-10-12, plan v1.9.0): the lineage register of `agentic-systems` is a named unit (row U2), by the same ruling (owner 2026-10-06) and on the folder name the package gave (`agentic-systems/09-lineage`, with its own VERSION.txt). Row C1 now says it also covers a frozen copy of a package's own earlier state, named `*-snapshot`: measured on a test layout, a folder `<name>-snapshot` with its own VERSION.txt inside it is not read by the structure check and raises no X1.

# v1.6.0 (2026-10-12, plan v1.12.0): the starter template of `agentic-systems` is a named example unit (row U3), by the owner's ruling of 2026-10-07 (examples are outside domain coverage and may be a unit of their own) and the folder name the package gave (`agentic-systems/10-starter-template`, with its own VERSION.txt).

# v1.7.0 (2026-10-13, plan v1.20.0): the named units of the governed packages are private content and left this table for a second file, OE_STRUCTURE_UNITS_v*.tsv (class, match, reason), read by oe_structure_classes_v1_2_0.py and added to the row of the same class; only the units of the method and of the governance package stay here. The table is also looked for under oe-method/04-documentation (found by the O4DE session).
